steps.name: limits
steps.query: query($i: DailyPostingLimitsInput!) { dailyPostingLimits(input:$i) { __typename ... on DailyPostingLimitStatus { channelId sent scheduled limit isAtLimit } } }

steps.name: create
steps.query: mutation($input: CreatePostInput!) { createPost(input: $input) { __typename ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id dueAt status } } ... on MutationError { message } } }
